ORDER (I) The First Appeal No. 1111/2023 and First Appeal No. 1870/2023 stand partly allowed.

(II) The appellants/land owners be paid compensation at the rate of Rs. 240/- per sq. ft. (inclusive of compensation granted by the learned Reference Court).
